g.text: AN/SMC-925 // SHEET 1 OF 2: MAIN CONTROL DECK (US LETTER 8.5×11" LANDSCAPE) — ALIGN FRAME: 240.00 × 154.00 MM
HOLD STEP + LATER PAD = NOTE LEN [1–32S] · HOLD STEP + RPT = RATCHET · REC + STEP = CHORD
HOLD RPT = TIMING · HOLD BANK = TRACKS [SRC+DST = COPY · +STOP = MUTE] · ⇧+REC SAVE / ⇧+PLAY LOAD
960 PPQN ENGINE · 16 TRACKS × 64 STEPS · USB-C + BLE + 3.5MM TRS MIDI OUT · AUTO-SAVE ON STOP · FW ≥ 925
